ModMetaData.name: FFF Aerospace Sample
ModMetaData.author: Fortified Features Framework
ModMetaData.description:
Example mod for FFF's aerospace framework (air defence, missiles). It extends the system without Harmony: - an infrared search sensor (IAirSensor) - a laser point-defence turret (IAirEffector, no fire control) - a scripted aircraft that air defence tracks and shoots at (IAirTrack) - a seeker that homes on power plants (GuidanceType; needs Dead Man's Switch: Expedition for missile bodies) - a faction doctrine written in XML (MissileDoctrineDef) - a weather modifier and an event listener (AirDefenseExtensionDef)
Copy this folder into Mods/ to try it. Source is in Source/.
